text: Refining D-0234 after #355's final review: a bound method is found before anything is unwrapped, so a wrapped method bound at module level counts only on its very object; an application method counts only when called on the class its staged module defines, found there by its code's qualified name, an instance or a subclass, by the receiver's real type; a __new__ still checks its first argument as the class it makes, so a transplanted one counts nothing; application code counts only in the module its source path names, so the staged file loaded again under another name counts nothing; and each thread keeps its own assertion depth and handed callables, so a worker thread inside an assertion neither hides the test method's assertions nor hands it callables.
